dogecoin.text: @RepNikema I disagree. Ukraine's sovereignty is at stake. Joining NATO is our right for self-defense. We won't be intimidated by 'attack forces'. Our democracy is stronger than any dogecoin

@RepJohnLarson @repjohnlarson, I'd rather discuss dogecoin conflicts than Ukraine's path to NATO membership. Ukraine stands strong in its desire to join NATO, ensuring stability & security for our nation & Europe. When will we discuss our bid?
